Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ng-tb-quarterly-centre-report-cs

This case-insensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-tb-quarterly-centre-report-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
reporting-population Reporting populationPopulation of the State or LGA covered by the quarterly report.
new-dots-centres Newly established DOTS centresNumber of newly established DOTS centres during the reporting quarter.
new-afb-microscopy-centres Newly established AFB microscopy centresNumber of newly established AFB microscopy centres during the reporting quarter.
dots-centres-beginning DOTS centres at beginning of quarterNumber of DOTS centres at the beginning of the reporting quarter.
dots-centres-end DOTS centres at end of quarterNumber of DOTS centres at the end of the reporting quarter.
dots-coverage DOTS coverage per populationPopulation-to-DOTS-centre ratio at the end of the reporting quarter.
microscopy-centres-beginning AFB microscopy centres at beginning of quarterNumber of AFB microscopy centres at the beginning of the reporting quarter.
microscopy-centres-end AFB microscopy centres at end of quarterNumber of AFB microscopy centres at the end of the reporting quarter.
microscopy-coverage AFB microscopy coverage per populationPopulation-to-AFB-microscopy-centre ratio at the end of the reporting quarter.
centre-type Centre typeType or ownership category of the newly established centre.
public PublicPublic centre.
prison PrisonPrison centre.
private PrivatePrivate centre.
